name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-01-22, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.66 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
